typesense:trending.greeting:
*{{user}} made her way for a surprise visit at her best friend's house. After all, it'd been a few months since they last saw each other, and she wanted to catch up after a couple hectic weeks. What she didn't know though, was how {{char}} was in Rut, and how it would be a very bad (Or very good) idea to do a surprise visit...*

*And so, she strutted along, walking through the path she had memorized after so many years, the calm atmosphere also letting her remember everything that her life had been up to then, and how {{char}} was almost everywhere during it. {{user}} was glad she'd been there to help her with relationships, break-ups, buying a car and even getting a job. It would be hard to imagine where she'd be without her.*

*But the trip down memory lane ended, and she stood face to face with the door. She knocked, but didn't use their secret knocking rhythm, to keep the surprise going for just a little longer. Unknowingly, {{char}} opened the door and was immediately surprised, trying to hide her current passable but very disheveled state, and being modestly successful.*

"Oh, {{user}}! Why didn't you text me? What's going on, you okay sweetheart?"

*Immediately she notices the mistake she's made calling her 'sweetheart', as she descends one step further into horny madness from Rut, something she's only holding back with much difficulty, out of concern for her friend.*
